# Mobile Extraction — Delegation Plan

**Audience:** weaker model executing extraction work in `apps/mobile`.
**Authority for decisions:** [`docs/design/mobile-extraction-rubric.md`](./mobile-extraction-rubric.md) (read first, every session).
**Input artifact:** `repomix-mobile.xml` at the mobile app root, generated by `pnpm pack:mobile`. If absent, run `pnpm pack:mobile` from the repo root before starting. Prefer reading this artifact over crawling files.

**Deliverable locations (create these directories on first use):**

- Phase 1 audit report → `docs/design/audits/<area>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md`
- Phase 2 proposals → `docs/design/audits/<area>-<YYYY-MM-DD>-proposals.yaml`
- Phase 4 ledger → `docs/design/extraction-ledger.md` (append-only; create on first ship)
  **Existing layers (do NOT invent new ones):**
- tokens → `packages/design-tokens/src/{primitives,semantic,motion}.ts`
- mobile design layer → `apps/mobile/src/design/{surfaces,screenLayout,animations,elevations,tokenAdapter}.ts`
- primitives → `apps/mobile/src/components/ui/*`
- templates → `apps/mobile/src/components/templates/*`

## Hard rules (apply every tranche)

1. **Phase gates are sequential.** Never extract during audit. Never propose during extraction. One phase per session.
2. **One feature area per session.** Pick from: `auth`, `bookings`, `chat`, `credits`, `disputes`, `matching`, `notifications`, `profile`, `review`, `tasks`, `verification`, or a screen family (`(customer)/tasks/*`, `(shared)/legal/*`, etc.).
3. **Never modify a file you didn't include in the proposal.**
4. **If you cannot name the abstraction in ≤3 words OR cannot define an API in ≤6 props, STOP and report. Do not extract.**
5. **Use Serena symbolic tools** (`mcp__serena__jet_brains_*`) for code navigation, grep for literal scans, repomix for breadth.
6. **Never run destructive git, never commit, never push.** Leave changes uncommitted for human review.

---

## Phase 1 — Audit (read-only)

**Goal:** produce a findings inventory. No code changes.

**Steps:**

1. Read `docs/design/mobile-extraction-rubric.md` end to end.
2. Run each query below across `apps/mobile/src/app` and `apps/mobile/src/components` (and `apps/mobile/src/features` for the chosen area).

**Query cookbook (run all, capture line counts per pattern). All queries scope to `apps/mobile/src` and exclude the design-tokens package and generated SDK to avoid false positives.**

```bash
# Raw geometry / spacing / radius — Tailwind arbitrary value syntax
rg -n "rounded-\[|px-\[|py-\[|gap-\[|p-\[|m-\[|w-\[|h-\[" apps/mobile/src

# Raw geometry — standard Tailwind utility classes that are common smells
rg -n "\b(p|m|gap|px|py|pt|pb|pl|pr)-(0\.5|1\.5|2\.5|3\.5)\b|\b(w|h|min-h|min-w)-(11|13|14|15|17|18)\b" apps/mobile/src

# Hardcoded colors / alphas — exclude design-tokens (authoritative source)
rg -n "bg-\[#|border-\[#|text-\[#|rgba?\(|#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}" apps/mobile/src --glob '!**/design/tokenAdapter.ts'

# Repeated visual rhythm constants (with and without space after colon)
rg -n "lineHeight:\s*(20|24|28)\b|letterSpacing:\s*0\.8\b|minHeight:\s*(44|48|56)\b" apps/mobile/src

# Pill / icon-box / avatar geometry as inline-style object literals
rg -n "(width|height):\s*(24|28|32|40|44|48|56|64|80|88|108|132)\b" apps/mobile/src

# Inline motion config (Reanimated APIs alone are NOT a smell — only inline numeric config is)
rg -n "withSpring\(\s*\{|withTiming\([0-9]|damping:\s*[0-9]|stiffness:\s*[0-9]|mass:\s*[0-9]" apps/mobile/src

# Repeated section wrappers
rg -n "rounded-lg p-lg gap-|bg-muted rounded-|text-caption font-bold uppercase" apps/mobile/src
```

**Cross-platform note:** if the same screen uses both NativeWind classes and inline styles for the same value (e.g., `w-12` next to `style={{ width: 48 }}`), record both as one finding — they're the same intent.

3. Cross-check whether each finding is **already covered** by:
   - `mobileSurfaces.*` (read `surfaces.ts`)
   - `semanticTokens.*` (read `semantic.ts`)
   - an existing `ui/` primitive
   - an existing `templates/` template

**Deliverable (no files touched):** a single markdown report with this shape per finding:

| id | sample literal | call sites (paths:lines) | semantic intent | already covered? | bucket guess (token/surface/primitive/template/local) |

Cap the report at 30 findings per session. If more, list highest-frequency first.

**Done criteria:**

- Report exists.
- Every finding has ≥2 call sites OR is flagged "single-use, leave local."
- No code edited.

---

## Phase 2 — Classify & Propose

**Goal:** turn the audit report into a small set of approved-or-rejected extraction proposals.

**Steps per finding:**

1. Apply the rubric's Decision Matrix (rules of three/two/one).
2. Run the **Nameability Test** and **API Stability Test** from the rubric.
3. Pick the **lowest stable layer** (token < surface < primitive < template).
4. If the proposal would require >6 props or any boolean escape hatches like `useCompactSpacing`, `backgroundOverride`, `variant: 'screen-a'`, **reject the proposal** and downgrade the layer (e.g., propose a surface instead of a primitive).

**Deliverable per accepted proposal:**

```yaml
id: P-007
finding_ids: [F-12, F-19, F-23]
layer: surface # token | surface | primitive | template
name: mobileSurfaces.disputeTimeline
intent: 'shared dot/rail geometry for timeline rows'
api: |
  { dotSize: 12, railWidth: 2, rowGap: 16 }   # values, not props
call_sites:
  - apps/mobile/src/app/(customer)/disputes/[disputeId]/index.tsx:142-178
  - apps/mobile/src/app/(customer)/bookings/[bookingId]/timeline.tsx:88-120
why_not_lower_layer: 'geometry is timeline-family-specific, not a global token'
why_not_higher_layer: 'no repeated markup yet; only repeated values'
risk: low
```

**Reject proposals that:**

- only have 1 call site (record as "leave local").
- collapse two patterns whose state semantics differ (loading/error/disabled diverge).
- would replace duplication with overrides (i.e., callers still pass custom styles).

**Done criteria:**

- Each finding from Phase 1 is either in a proposal or marked "leave local with reason."
- Proposals are written to a new file in the report; **no source files edited.**

---

## Phase 3 — Extract (one proposal at a time)

Only run after a human approves specific proposal IDs. **Never extract a proposal that was not explicitly approved.**

**Order of extraction (lowest layer first within the approved set):** tokens → surfaces → primitives → templates.

**Per extraction:**

1. Add the new value/component/template in the canonical location.
2. Update each call site listed in the proposal — only those.
3. Verify with:
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @tasky/mobile typecheck
   pnpm --filter @tasky/mobile lint
   pnpm --filter @tasky/mobile test
   ```
4. Stop and report. Do not start the next proposal in the same session.

**Hard limits per extraction:**

- ≤1 new exported symbol.
- ≤8 files modified (the new file + its call sites). If more, split the proposal.
- Zero new props added "for the future."
- If any call site needs a custom override to compile, **revert that call site** and note it as a divergence — do not extend the API to accommodate.

**Done criteria:**

- Typecheck, lint, tests pass.
- `git diff` shows duplication actually removed (compare deleted lines vs added lines; net should be ≤0 outside the new file).
- Working tree left uncommitted.

---

## Phase 4 — Reconcile

After a batch of approved extractions ships, re-run the audit queries from Phase 1 against the same feature area. Compare counts before/after. Append a one-line entry to a running ledger (e.g., `docs/design/extraction-ledger.md` if you create one — propose first):

```
2026-04-17 | disputes | surface mobileSurfaces.disputeTimeline | -34 raw literals | net -12 LOC
```

---

## Anti-patterns (auto-reject these without asking)

- Generic `CardSection`, `ContentBlock`, `BoxWrapper`.
- Components with `variant: 'screen-a' | 'screen-b'`.
- Primitive that wraps exactly one caller.
- Token added for a single-use value.
- Centralizing a unique animation (one-off ring, one-off glow) into shared motion presets.

---

## Escalation triggers (stop and ask the human)

- Two proposals naturally collide (same name, different intent).
- A proposal spans both the customer and tasker variants — semantics may differ.
- Existing surface/primitive looks close but doesn't fit; tempted to widen its API.
- Tests would need to change beyond import paths.
- More than 8 files would be touched by a single extraction.

---

**Suggested first session:** Phase 1 audit on `apps/mobile/src/app/(customer)/disputes/*` and `bookings/[bookingId]/timeline.tsx` — both are in the current dirty working tree and likely share timeline geometry.
